t: Look up at the tall wedge-shaped skyscraper in front of you. This is 122 Leadenhall Street, known as the Leadenhall Building, or more informally the Cheesegrater, because its sloping shape looks like the kitchen utensil. It stands 225 metres high and opened in July 2014. It was designed by Rogers Stirk Harbour and Partners, the practice founded by Richard Rogers, a British and Italian architect known for modernist, high-tech buildings.
